Strong cybersecurity and IT risk experience. Exposure to operational technology (OT) is an advantage.

If you’ve led technology in an oil trading business and want the scope to shape its next major systems programme, apply now. We’d love to hear which trading platforms you’ve owned and what you’ve delivered.

d: We are a well-established Hong Kong-based brokerage and diversified financial services firm with a 40-year track record. As part of our international expansion, we are preparing to establish regulated operations in Oman and obtain the relevant licences from the Financial Services Authority (FSA) of Oman.

We are seeking an experienced Head of Risk Management to lead our risk management function in Oman. Reporting directly to the Board of Directors / CEO, this senior leadership role will be instrumental in establishing the local risk management framework, supporting the licensing process, building the risk team, and ensuring robust controls across securities brokerage, margin financing, new products, and business initiatives in accordance with Omani laws, FSA regulations, and international best practices.
Develop, implement, and enhance risk management policies, procedures, methodologies, and control frameworks.
Lead credit control, margin call management, and credit approval for margin clients within the securities brokerage business.
Review and provide risk recommendations on credit limit applications for securities, futures, and options businesses.
Provide business requirements for IT system development relating to risk management and regulatory requirements, and participate in user acceptance testing (UAT).
Conduct risk assessments for new products and business initiatives; develop appropriate risk policies, procedures, systems, and daily monitoring workflows.
Prepare regular risk management reports and regulatory submissions required by the FSA or other relevant authorities.
Build, lead, and develop the local risk management team to support business growth and strategic initiatives.
Work closely with senior management, business teams, compliance, operations, and technology functions to maintain a strong risk culture.
Minimum 8–10 years of relevant risk management experience within the securities industry; experience in securities brokerage and margin financing is essential.
At least 6 years of relevant experience gained from sizeable securities firms or financial institutions.
Bachelor’s degree or above in Risk Management, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
FRM, CFA, or other professional qualifications in risk or financial management are preferred.
Strong knowledge of credit risk management methodologies, risk control processes, and margin financing controls.
In-depth understanding of local regulations applicable to brokerage and margin business in Oman; familiarity with FSA requirements is highly desirable.
Experience in system implementation, project management, and/or UAT.
Excellent written and spoken English is essential; Mandarin proficiency is an advantage.
Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
High standards of professional ethics, integrity, and internal control awareness.

d: Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.

Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

We're looking for a Senior Operations Associate - Shops to own the performance of our Shops marketplace across the UAE and Jordan. This is a purely marketplace mandate so your world is Shops partners, their in-store picking teams, and the KPIs that determine a delightful customer experience. You'll sit at the intersection of Shops partners operations, strategic planning, and hands-on picking excellence.
q: 1-3 years in operations, quick-commerce, last-mile logistics, or retail/e-commerce marketplace roles, with at least 2 years managing teams and external partners directly.
Experience managing frontline or in-store operations (picking, warehousing, fulfillment) - you've been on the floor, not just in the dashboard.
Strong data fluency (Excel/SQL and BI tools) paired with the judgment to know when a number needs a conversation, not just a chart.
Willingness to travel regularly between the UAE and Jordan.
Must be fluent in English; Arabic fluency is preferred

Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
Work 4 days a week in office & 1 day from home, and remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.
